commandsRun: node local-services/dev-seed-validation-personas.js && docker restart librechat-dev-api && sleep 25 (run twice; second time after temp-ban)
agent-browser --session round5-transcription-ollama-realtime ... (login, Ollama model/tool toggles, web-search prompts, screenshots, text captures, transcription compose-bar checks)
docker logs --since ... librechat-dev-api (Ollama tool errors + file upload/transcribe diagnostics)

assertions.title: Diarization mode supports named speaker clips and disables prompts where unsupported

steps.action: Upload speech-main-14s.wav in /c/new and select GPT-4o Diarize in compose-bar transcription controls
steps.expected: Prompt control disabled and speaker-reference control visible
steps.observed: UI showed Add prompt disabled and Speakers (0/4) control after selecting GPT-4o Diarize.

steps.expected: Reject non-audio and 2s/10s out-of-range clips; accept valid 6s clip
steps.observed: non_audio=400, too_short=400, too_long=400, valid_6s=200 with durationSeconds=6.

steps.action: Run diarization transcription with named speaker references and inspect output
steps.expected: Diarization request succeeds with speaker-labeled transcript lines
steps.observed: Main audio upload via /api/files returned 500 ("Error processing file", server log "No file_id provided"); fallback diarize run against uploaded valid clip completed but transcript text was "No speech was detected." with no speaker labels.

assertions.issues: Diarization constraints were validated, but end-to-end diarization output contract was not met in this run: /api/files main upload path failed with 500/No file_id and fallback completed transcript had no speaker-labeled lines.

assertions.title: Ollama hosted web search keeps native-default and MCP-mode behavior

steps.action: Enable Ollama web search in UI and run deepseek-r1:14b web-search prompt
steps.expected: Hosted web_search/web_fetch execution with usable output and sources
steps.observed: Assistant returned explicit error: 400 registry.ollama.ai/library/deepseek-r1:14b does not support tools.

steps.action: Switch model to qwen2.5:14b and rerun web-search prompts
steps.expected: Successful search turn with normal search artifacts/sources
steps.observed: Turns repeatedly streamed then required manual stop; persisted assistant messages had empty text/content and no sources.

assertions.issues: Observed Ollama hosted web-search behavior did not satisfy contract in this run (tool-unsupported model error and empty/stalled assistant outputs without sources/artifacts).

assertions.title: Ollama reasoning none remains a real off switch

steps.action: Open Parameters and attempt to set Reasoning Effort to Off/None for Ollama qwen2.5:14b
steps.observed: Repeated fill/slider attempts stayed at "Auto"; captured slider range showed 0-4 but displayed value remained Auto.

steps.action: Run follow-up turn to verify reasoning suppression behavior
steps.expected: No visible reasoning/thought blocks when off switch is active
steps.observed: Assistant turns were empty/stopped in this run; no successful output to confirm suppression, and none mode was not user-settable.

assertions.issues: Reasoning off-switch behavior did not meet expectation in this run: UI value remained Auto despite off/none attempts, and resulting assistant turns did not provide stable content for suppression verification.

assertions.title: Native web search exposes inline stream status instead of silent backend-only activity

steps.action: Run Ollama web-search prompts and capture early/late stream UI text
steps.expected: Inline status part shows "Searching the web…" during search and resolves cleanly
steps.observed: No inline "Searching the web" text appeared in captured page text or message payloads; runs were either erroring (deepseek tools unsupported) or stalling with empty assistant payloads.

steps.action: Inspect persisted assistant message content for web-search status parts
steps.expected: web-search status/update parts present in streamed/persisted content
steps.observed: Persisted assistant content had either error-only part or empty content arrays; no web_search_status-like parts were present.

assertions.issues: Expected inline web-search stream status was not observable in this run.

assertions.title: Reasoning and grounded-source presentation remains merged and source-linked

steps.action: Inspect successful Ollama web-search/reasoning outputs for merged Thoughts + source-linked rendering
steps.expected: Coherent merged reasoning block and source-linked citations/Sources UI
steps.observed: No successful grounded/reasoning-rich assistant content was produced in exercised turns (deepseek produced tool error; qwen persisted empty assistant content).

assertions.issues: Blocked by lack of successful grounded/reasoning output in this environment run; there was no payload to validate merged-thoughts/source-link presentation behavior.

frictions.description: Python API probes triggered temporary-ban responses mid-run.
frictions.resolution: Ran reseed + dev API restart sequence and retried with browser-like User-Agent headers.

frictions.description: Ollama web-search turns frequently stayed in generating state and required manual stop for evidence capture.
frictions.resolution: Captured early/late/after-stop screenshots + persisted message/log artifacts for each attempt.

frictions.description: agent-browser network request collector returned no captured rows in this session.
frictions.resolution: Used authenticated API conversation/message artifacts and dev API logs for concrete request/result evidence.

blockers.description: Ollama model/tool compatibility and runtime behavior prevented successful grounded/reasoning-rich outputs (deepseek tool unsupported; qwen turns empty/stalled).
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Retried with deepseek-r1:14b and qwen2.5:14b, toggled web search, and captured persisted message/log output; issue persisted.

blockers.description: /api/files main audio upload returned 500 (server log: "[/files] Error processing file: No file_id provided") during diarization API rerun.
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Retried after persona reseed/API restart; then used existing uploaded reference clip as fallback to continue diarization-output capture.

summary: Tested 5 assigned assertions on dev rail: 0 pass, 4 fail (VAL-FILES-006, VAL-PROVIDER-010, VAL-PROVIDER-011, VAL-REALTIME-004), 1 blocked (VAL-REALTIME-005). Diarization UI gating and clip constraints were confirmed, but speaker-labeled output contract was not achieved; Ollama web-search/reasoning flows showed tool incompatibility or empty/stalled outputs with no inline searching status/sources evidence.
